TI Method for intelligent tracing of micro-plastic            discharge in offshore area, involves inputting            multi-source data set into pre-constructed intelligent            traceability model, and outputting traceability result            calculated by intelligent traceability model.
AU LU Y
   ZHI L
   PAN T
   XIAO J
   HU M
AE GUANGDONG YUNAN TESTING TECHNOLOGY CO (GUAN-Non-standard)
GA 202617463P
AB    NOVELTY - The method involves obtaining environmental                dynamics element information and micro-plastic                observation information affecting micro-plastic                transportation and distribution in a target                offshore area. A multi-source data set is                constructed. An offshore specific physical                mechanism is characterized by the environmental                dynamic element according to the multi-source data                set. A pollutant space-time distribution                characteristic is characterized by the                micro-plastic observation information. The offshore                specific physical mechanism is used as a constraint                condition to perform training on an artificial                intelligent model. An intelligent traceability                model is obtained such that the intelligent                traceability model learns a micro-plastic conveying                rule driven by a physical mechanism. The                multi-source data set is input into a                pre-constructed intelligent traceability model. A                traceability result calculated by the intelligent                traceability model is output.
   USE - Method for intelligent tracing of                micro-plastic discharge in offshore area.
   ADVANTAGE - The method flexibly deals with the data                usability difference of different offshore                environments, obtains the traceability conclusion                with high interpretability, and accurately                identifies the emission source space                position.
   DETAILED DESCRIPTION - An INDEPENDENT CLAIM is included for a                micro-plastic discharge intelligent tracing system                for offshore area.
   DESCRIPTION OF DRAWING(S) - The drawing shows a schematic diagram of a                micro-plastic discharge intelligent tracing method                for offshore temporary domain. (Drawing includes                non-English language text).

PN CN121167618-A
TI Method for tracing micro-plastic pollution used in            water pollution tracing field, involves performing            micro-plastic pollution traceability and pollution            alarm according to dynamic threshold, dynamic risk            level and traceability model.
AU JIANG P
   ZHANG M
   HUANG J
   ZHOU T
   CHEN C
   QIAN J
   ZHANG Y
   CHENG H
   PAN Y
   LU S
   LEI S
   DING J
AE UNIV JIANGNAN (UYJN-C)
   TAIHU INNOVATION WUXI TECHNOLOGY RES CO LTD (TAIH-Non-standard)
GA 202604081X
AB    NOVELTY - The method involves receiving micro-plastic                data, where the micro-plastic data comprises social                economic plastic data, micro-plastic multi-mode                characteristic data and space heterogeneity network                data. The micro-plastic data is cleaned,                standardized and space aligned. A micro-plastic                pollution source space-time graph is constructed.                The micro-plastic pollution source space-time graph                is defined and strengthened according to the                micro-plastic data to obtain a reinforced                micro-plastic pollution source space-time graph.                Space-time dependent modeling is performed on the                reinforced micro-plastic pollution source                space-time graph to obtain a dynamic pollution                propagation probability graph. Model training is                performed by using the fusion multimodal feature                and the dynamic pollution propagation probability                graph to obtain a traceability model. Micro-plastic                pollution traceability and pollution alarm are                performed according to the dynamic threshold and                the traceability model.
   USE - Method for tracing micro-plastic pollution                used in water pollution tracing field.
   ADVANTAGE - The method enables improving the tracing                precision of the micro-plastic pollution.
   DETAILED DESCRIPTION - INDEPENDENT CLAIMS are included for: (1) a                micro-plastic pollution tracing system; (2) a                computer device; (3) a computer-readable storage                medium.
   DESCRIPTION OF DRAWING(S) - The drawing shows a flow diagram illustrating                a method for tracing micro-plastic pollution.                (Drawing includes non-English language                text).

This                can be burned permanently into memory when the                circuit is manufactured and/or may be recorded on                first use, to assure traceability in subsequent                tests.
TF TECHNOLOGY FOCUS - INSTRUMENTATION AND TESTING - Preferred Features: The container is molded                  plastic, the circuit being embedded into it. The                  circuit is an integrated circuit. It includes an                  induction loop to supply the circuit. In addition                  it has a receiver for personalized information,                  which is recorded in the electronic memory.                  Function is blocked by the analysis equipment,                  should no sample be detected, or inconsistency is                  detected in the analysis, storage or operation to                  be carried out. The analysis equipment reads                  signals emitted by the container, providing                  information on the results of analysis. The                  identification zone is limited to within 20                  cm.

AU MAGUIRE S B
   MAGUIRE P S
AE MAGUIRE PROD INC (MAGU-Non-standard)
   MAGUIRE PROD INC (MAGU-Non-standard)
   MAGUIRE S B (MAGU-Individual)
   MAGUIRE P S (MAGU-Individual)
GA 1999034781
AB    NOVELTY - This new method weight-blends granular                materials. An operational command generated                remotely, is encoded into transportable time-stable                machine readable tangible storage media. At a bar                code reader connected to the blender, it is                scanned, inputting the code into a microprocessor                controlling the blender (11).
Also claimed is apparatus managing                weight-blending of granular materials. Data                transfer as described, transmits the desired blend                to executive equipment, including a bin below a                hopper. Sensed bin weight is reported to the                microprocessor regulating operation.
Also claimed is a gravimetric blender                including housing, material storage hopper (12), a                bin (15) below, weight sensor (load cell) and                management equipment as described, to control                dispensing and weighing. A mixing chamber (20)                below the bin accepts and mixes the measured                material.
   USE - To weigh and blend granular material                automatically, delivering instructions from a                remote location.
   ADVANTAGE - The method typically blends plastic granules                and liquids, supplied to pressure                injection-moulding, compression-moulding and                extrusion equipment. The blend includes: recycled                regrind, virgin resin, flake- or freeze dried                colour and additives influencing processing.                Feedstock variability and subjectivity cause                incorrect dosing, avoidable by the new method.                There is no direct manual input to the                microprocessor. Feedback of requirements from                product measurements to blending, is facilitated.                Direct dosing into the processing machine throat is                avoided. Shock loading and vibration, interfering                with load cell signals is prevented. Instructions                can be machine- and operator-specific. Traceability                is improved.

AB    NOVELTY - The plastic tracking fastener (100) has an                elongated unit (110) comprising a distal end (130)                and a proximal end (150). A wireless identification                device (160) is partially positioned in the                proximal end of the plastic tracking fastener. The                wireless identification device contains                electronically stored information. A primary and a                secondary antenna are partially positioned in the                proximal end of the plastic tracking fastener.    USE - Plastic tracking fastener for tracking items                using plastic tracking fasteners with radio                frequency identification tags.
   ADVANTAGE - The chain of custody leads to better inventory                control, efficient transport and a reduction in                timber losses.    DETAILED DESCRIPTION - INDEPENDENT CLAIMS are included for the                following:
   a method for tracking an object using a                tracking fastener;
   a method for tracking a log using a tracking                fastener; and
   a method for tracking a pallet of goods using                a tracking fastener.

PN CN122153501-A
TI Method for tracing atmospheric micro-plastic based            on clustering analysis and factor analysis, involves            endowing specific environmental source physical meaning            to each analyzed potential factor, and outputting            quantitative contribution rate and space-time            distribution characteristic of each source.
AU SHI S
   HUO S
   WU B
   LIU B
   ZHANG J
   YU X
AE UNIV JIANGSU SCI & TECHNOLOGY (UYJG-C)
GA 202658383C
AB    NOVELTY - The method involves pre-processing abundance                data of different types of micro-plastic in                obtained multiple environmental samples. A                clustering analysis algorithm is used according to                similarity of abundance change mode of each                micro-plastic type in all samples. The                pre-processed abundance data is obtained. A                clustering distribution list is obtained. A factor                analysis model is used for the pre-processed                abundance data. Multiple potential factors playing                a dominant role for variability of the whole data                are analyzed. A factor correlation matrix is                calculated to obtain factor correlation                distribution information. Cross analysis and mutual                verification are performed according to the                clustering distribution table and the factor                correlation distribution information. Specific                environmental source physical meaning is endowed to                each analyzed potential factor. A quantitative                contribution rate and space-time distribution                characteristic of each source are output.
   USE - Method for tracing atmospheric micro-plastic                based on clustering analysis and factor analysis in                environment monitoring and data analysis field.                Uses include but are not limited to plastic                particles, fibers or fragments of less than 5 mm in                diameter.
   ADVANTAGE - The method enables realizing objective,                accurate and quantifiable analysis of the                atmospheric micro-plastic source through the                multi-element counting method driven by data.
   DESCRIPTION OF DRAWING(S) - The drawing shows an overall flow diagram of                the traceability method. (Drawing includes                non-English language text).

AB    NOVELTY - Method involves obtaining operation data and                system benzene-alkene ratio output value of a                target benzene alkene ratio control system under                multiple preset working conditions. The operation                data is pre-processed. Multiple characteristic                factors are obtained related to a health condition                of the target benzene alkene Ratio control system. The real class imbalance data                and the generated data are taken as a complete                evaluation data set. The comprehensive evaluation                data sets are inputted into a constructed                anatomically constrained neural networks (ACNN)                health evaluation model. The system is outputted.                The health evaluation is realized according to the                system is realized. The non-optimal factor is                reduced through an ACNN in an attention mechanism                traceability.
   USE - Health evaluation method of benzene-alkene                ratio control system based on class imbalance data                enhancement used in production and preparation of                rubber, synthetic plastic and pesticide.

The ACNN                health evaluation model attention mechanism,                traceability causes the non-optimal factor of the                target benzene alkene ratio control system health                level.

AU LI K
   YE Y
   JIANG W
   KE Y
AE UNIV QUANZHOU NORMAL (UQZN-C)
GA 202562726Y
AB    NOVELTY - The method involves obtaining multi-spectral                image data of a financial payment terminal product                for generating a first image set including surface                defect and internal welding information. De-noising                filtering and contrast enhancement processing is                performed on the first image set to generate a                second image set. A convolution neural network                model of the plastic shell and the metal circuit                board is established according to the                characteristic set for generating a first model set                of adaptive material difference through migration                learning. Defect detection is performed on a                real-time multi-spectral image through a second                model set for generating a defect set containing                defect position, type and severity degree. TI Detecting metal impurity particles of lithium            battery material, involves absorbing and collecting            metal particles at bottom of beaker, extracting metal            particles, mounting filter paper in filter bottle of            filter device, adding carboxymethylcellulose glue            solution.
AU DENG H
   JIANG X
   XU Y
   XU F
   SONG J
   ZHOU L
AE HUIZHOU EVE ENERGY GATHERING CO LTD (EVNE-C)
GA 202448314M
AB    NOVELTY - Detecting metal impurity particles of lithium                battery material, involves adding proper amount of                sample and solvent into the polytetrafluoroethylene                barrel; using the plastic thin tube to cover the                magnetic rod, then using the heat sealing machine                to seal the plastic thin tube covered with the                magnetic rod, and then putting the magnetic rod                containing plastic thin tube into the                polytetrafluoroethylene barrel; sealing the sample,                solvent, the polytetrafluoroethylene barrel of the                magnetic rod and placing in a tank mill for mixing,                after finishing, taking out magnetic rod, peeling                off plastic thin pipe from magnetic rod, placing in                a clean beaker, adding de-ionized water, using                ultrasonic cleaning instrument for ultrasonic                treatment, until there is no residue on the plastic                thin pipe, taking out the plastic tube from the                beaker; purifying sample, using small magnetic rod                to surround the bottom of the cup wall of the                beaker, absorbing and collecting metal particles at                bottom of beaker.
   USE - Method for detecting metal impurity particles                of lithium battery material.
   ADVANTAGE - The method can effectively and completely                identify the presence of impurity particles in the                lithium electric material, comprising simple                substance, the compound or mixture, and the                information such as element type, shape, provide                direct and accurate location for the short circuit                point-metal impurity particle traceability                influencing the self-discharge of the electric                core, and form the advantage complementation with                the inductive coupled plasma (ICP) detection, as                the important measure of the metal impurity control                in the current lithium electric production.
   DETAILED DESCRIPTION - Detecting metal impurity particles of lithium                battery material, involves adding proper amount of                sample and solvent into the polytetrafluoroethylene                barrel; using the plastic thin tube to cover the                magnetic rod, then using the heat sealing machine                to seal the plastic thin tube covered with the                magnetic rod, and then putting the magnetic rod                containing the plastic thin tube into the                polytetrafluoroethylene barrel; sealing the sample,                solvent, the polytetrafluoroethylene barrel of the                magnetic rod and then placing in a tank mill for                mixing, after finishing, taking out the magnetic                rod, peeling off the plastic thin pipe from the                magnetic rod, then placing in a clean beaker,                adding de-ionized water, using ultrasonic cleaning                instrument for ultrasonic treatment, until there is                no residue on the plastic thin pipe, taking out the                plastic tube from the beaker; purifying the sample,                using a small magnetic rod to surround the bottom                of the cup wall of the beaker, absorbing and                collecting the metal particles at the bottom of the                beaker, pouring the solution, repeating the process                until the solution is clear; extracting the metal                particles, mounting the filter paper in the filter                bottle of the filter device, pouring the clear                solution containing the metal particles to filter                until there is no obvious bead on the surface of                the filter paper, then adding                carboxymethylcellulose (CMC) glue solution, fixing                on the slide; energy dispersive X-Ray spectroscopy                (EDS) component analysis, after cutting the filter                film containing impurity particles, using                conductive adhesive to adhere on the EDS object                stage, firstly performing metal spraying treatment,                then performing EDS component analysis.
TF TECHNOLOGY FOCUS - ORGANIC CHEMISTRY - Preferred Components: The solvent is the                  mixture of de-ionized water and                  N-methyl-2-pyrrolidone (NMP) solution.

TI Smart card e.g. contactless tag, for e.g. banking            application, has embossing area situated outside one            coil and inside another coil of antenna, and insulating            glue deposited on flexible film.
AU LAUNAY F
   VENAMBRE J
   LIMELETTE Y
   BARBOTIN A
AE OBERTHUR CARD SYSTEMS SA (OBET-C)
   OBERTHUR TECHNOLOGIES (OBET-C)
   OBERTHUR TECHNOLOGIES (OBET-C)
   OBERTHUR TECHNOLOGIES (OBET-C)

AB    NOVELTY - The card has a magnetic antenna with coils                (26, 28) and placed on a flexible film with a                thickness between 40 and 100 micrometers. An                embossing area (24) is situated outside the coil                (26) and inside the coil (28). The coil (28) is                situated at a card`s periphery and the coil (26) is                situated in a card`s rectangular part. An                insulating glue e.g. MK55 glue, is deposited on the                film. The glue has a softening temperature that                does not differ from a maximum temperature of hot                lamination cycle of a plastic structure of the                card, by more than 40 degrees. The glue is viscous                at the maximum temperature.
   USE - Smartcard e.g. contactless tag and flip chip,                used in banking application, radiofrequency                identification and traceability applications.
   ADVANTAGE - The embossing area is situated outside one of                the coils of the antenna and inside the other coil                of the antenna, thus optimizing equivalent surface                of the antenna in spite of the presence of the                embossing area. The magnetic antenna is placed on                the flexible film having the thickness comprised                between 40 and 100 micrometers, thus resisting                bending stresses applied on the card and reducing                deformation phenomena during the operation of                lamination of a plastic structure of the card. The                flexible film resists temperatures greater than 100                degrees, while avoiding embedding of the                microcircuit in the structure, during lamination                operation, thus further limiting damages of a land                and the coils of the antenna. The insulating glue                is viscous at the maximum temperature and has the                softening temperature that is not less than 40                degrees of the maximum temperature of hot                lamination cycle of the plastic structure of the                card, so that the glue does not flow in an                excessive manner, during the lamination of the                plastic structure, thus preventing damage to                connections between the microcircuit and the land.                The coils are arranged such that a surface                comprised inside the coils is maximized, and hence                the performance of the antenna is optimized.
   DETAILED DESCRIPTION - An INDEPENDENT CLAIM is also included for a                method for manufacturing a smartcard.
   DESCRIPTION OF DRAWING(S) - The drawing shows a smart card.

   26, 28Magnetic antenna coils

AE BELLON J M (BELL-Individual)
   REY A (REYA-Individual)
GA 2006256064
AB    NOVELTY - The unit has electric wires (1) that are partially integrated within a plastic support (2) to form a structural unit for defining repulsive zones (4) in staggered rows. An electrical contact with entire body of an animal or a part external to the structural unit is intervened at the level of the zones. The support presents colors, and is made up of mixture of high density polyethylene and low density polyethylene.
   USE - Linear unit e.g. strip, rope or cord, for an electric fence (claimed), which is used for protecting property e.g. farm property or cultivation, for penning bred animals on a terrain of limited surface, or for dissuading animals from approaching the cultivation.

The electric fence thus can be manufactured in more reasonable cost. The support presents colors to improve visibility of the linear unit or to facilitate recognition at commercial purposes, traceability, production and storage. The support is made up of mixture of high density polyethylene and low density polyethylene, in order to accomplish better trade-off between rigidity and flexibility of the support. The repulsive zones are placed in staggered rows, thus permitting to increase probability of electric contact of the body of the animal and to optimize mechanical resistance of the linear unit.
   DETAILED DESCRIPTION - An INDEPENDENT CLAIM is also included for a strip for an electric fence.

   USE - Solid-state barcode for managing large quantities of articles such as plastic items, metal items, wood items, and packaged items e.g. packaged foods and packaged pharmaceuticals.
   ADVANTAGE - The shell portion can protect the core portion from damage that is caused by external factors such as moisture and impact during handling. The shell portion can maintain the different regions of the core portion in the pattern that encodes the information so that the pattern does not change over time. The paints can prevent the barcodes from dissociating from the object during the lifetime of the object thus preventing the loss of information that relates to the object. The paint can be easily applied onto smooth and uneven surfaces. The scanner can acquire images of the patterns of different colored regions on the core portions and/or shell portions of the solid-state barcodes. The polymeric materials can be used to produce the core-shell fiber or solid-state barcode as long as the material can remain stable when exposed to heat generated during the extrusion process such as the electrospinning process. The improved traceability that is realized by solid-state barcodes can be suitably applied to copy management, recycling, processed food and any other industry where traceability or coded information can improve product use and function.

PN IN202521062847-A
TI System for controlling airflow in extruder used in            plastics and polymer industries for extruding e.g.            tubes, has control unit that determines deviation            between measured attributes received from inspection            unit and corresponding predefined attributes stored            within control unit.
AU PATEL C S
   SHAIKH S T
   SHAH G D
   MIRZA Z A
   KOTHWALA D M
AE MERIL LIFE SCI PVT LTD (MERI-Non-standard)
GA 2025B0982S
AB    NOVELTY - The system (300) has a die head (112) for                extruding a tube. A regulator (304) regulates                supply of airflow to the die head of the extruder                (110). An inspection unit (302) measures the                attributes of the extruded tube. A control unit                (308) is coupled to the inspection unit and the                regulator. The control unit determines a deviation                between the measured attributes received from the                inspection unit and corresponding predefined                attributes stored within the control unit. The                control unit compares the determined deviation with                an allowable tolerance range. The control unit                directs the regulator to adjust the airflow based                aforesaid comparison. The attributes comprise an                inner diameter, an outer diameter, a wall                thickness, and an ovality or roundness of the                extruded tube, or a surface quality or smoothness                of the extruded tube or puncture. A display unit                (135) is coupled to the control unit. The display                unit displays real-time and historical data related                to the extruded tube.
   USE - System for controlling airflow in extruder                used in plastics and polymer industries for                extruding tubes, films, sheets, profiles and                cables.
   ADVANTAGE - The system ensures that a controlled and                consistent airflow is maintained within the                extruded tube as the semi-solid tube exits the                extrusion die head, by preventing the collapse of                the tube walls. The system ensures that the                dimensions of subsequent tubes produced after the                adjustment consistently fall within the specified                tolerance limits. The extruded tube is delivered                onto the conveyor unit , which transports the                extruded tube at a consistent, controlled rate,                ensuring production uniformity and minimizing the                risk of stretching or deformation. The system                enables immediate corrective action via real-time                comparison of tube attributes against threshold                values, to adjust the attributes of the subsequent                tubes to be extruded to significantly reduce                material wastage, running downtime and enhances                process stability. The system allows flexible                operation through a user-friendly interface for                modifying attribute thresholds and supports process                traceability and continuous improvement with its                historical data storage capabilities, compatibility                with a variety of sensor types including laser                micrometers, ultrasonic gauges, and optical                sensors, enables versatile deployment across                diverse extrusion applications, and ensures                reliable performance and high product                consistency.
   DETAILED DESCRIPTION - An INDEPENDENT CLAIM is included for a method                for controlling airflow of an extruder.
   DESCRIPTION OF DRAWING(S) - The drawing shows a schematic view of a                system for controlling airflow in extruder.

AB    NOVELTY - The method (200) involves providing (202) an                object identifier comprising input material data                through an interface. The input material data is                indicative of multiple property of the input                material. The process data is received (204) from                the device through the interface. The process data                is indicative of the process parameters and/or                device operating conditions that the input material                is processed. A portion of the process data is                appended (206) to the object identifier. The input                material for the processing through the device is                divided into two packages.    DETAILED DESCRIPTION - An INDEPENDENT CLAIM is included for a system                for manufacturing a chemical product at an                industrial plant by processing an input                material.

TI Removable edible label for labelling food            products, is free of adhesive layer, and has preset            swelling rate in water and pH value and can be stuck to            food product throughout slaughtering until            packaging.
AU MASER F
   TUERK O
AE NATURIN GMBH & CO (NATU-Non-standard)
   NATURIN GMBH & CO (NATU-Non-standard)
   MASER F (MASE-Individual)
   TUERK O (TUER-Individual)
GA 2002548178
AB    NOVELTY - Removable edible label based on collagen for                labelling food products, is free of any adhesive                layer, and has a swelling rate in water between                120-450% and a pH value between 5.5-10.0. The label                can be stuck to the food product throughout the                slaughter process until packaging and is removed                from the food product whenever desired.
   USE - Used in meat and poultry processing for                sausage manufacture. Also used in cheese or smoked                fish manufacture.
   ADVANTAGE - The label is able to function as carrier of                traceability-relative information such as barcode                and is available at reasonable price. The label                does not pose damage to machine and complies with                all food safety and hygiene aspects. The label can                be used on standard printer equipment and reliably                stuck to piece of meat even during cold storage and                transportation. The label can be easily and                completely removed from the labelled product. The                remnants of the label do not represent foreign                bodies in the final sausage, such as metal,                plastic, cardboard or paper. The label is stuffed                along with meat emulsion and does not represent a                source of food hazard.
   DETAILED DESCRIPTION - INDEPENDENT CLAIMS are included for the                following:
   Preparation of an edible film from an                appropriate collagen gel, which involves extruding                the collagen gel into a tubular or flat film which                is cross-linked, so that the swelling rate of the                film in water is 120-450%, and has controlled pH of                5.5-10.0; and
   Use of the edible film in preparation of                removable labels.
TF TECHNOLOGY FOCUS - FOOD - Preferred Product: The removable label is                  used for meat products and poultry                  products.
   TECHNOLOGY FOCUS - ORGANIC CHEMISTRY - Preferred Properties: The edible label and                  film have swelling rate of 120-270%, preferably                  180-250%, in water, and has pH between 5.5-8.5.                  Preferred Component: The label and edible film                  have collagen as main component based on weight.                  Removable edible label comprises minor amounts of                  at least one component selected from polyols,                  cellulose, hydrocolloids, non-collagenous                  proteins and food approved dyes. The polyol is                  glycerine. Preferred Composition: The label                  contains (in %) polyol (0-30, preferably 0-15),                  cellulose fiber (0-25, preferably 3-20),                  hydrocolloid (0-45, preferably 5-20),                  non-collagenous protein (0-45, preferably 0-20),                  and food approved dyes (0-10 based on collagen).                  Preferred Hydrocolloid: The hydrocolloid is                  modified cellulose, aliginic acid, alginate,                  carrageenan, xanthan gum, locust bean gum,                  pectin, guar gum, arabic gum, tragacant gum                  and/or tara gum. Preferred Non-collagenous                  Protein: The non-collagenous protein is at least                  gelatin, soy protein, gluten, casein and/or zein.                  . Preferred Dyes: The food approved dye is                  titanium dioxide, iron oxides (red, yellow,                  black), carmine, annatto, Red 3, Red 40, sunset                  yellow, caramel and/or carbon black. Preferred                  Label: The edible film is cut to prepare labels.                  The label has width of 10-200 mm and wall                  thickness between 25-200 &#956;m, preferably                  40-80 &#956;m. Any of the motifs such as                  written information, drawings, graphics and                  painting, are hand-written or printed using                  thermo transfer printer, ink-jet printer or laser                  printer, on the label. An edible ink is employed                  for printing.
   EXAMPLE - A collagen gel based on bovine hide splits was                prepared and pH of gel was adjusted to 2.8. The gel                contained (in kg) water (3420), collagen (400),                glycerine (120), cellulose powder (30), titanium                dioxide (28) and glyoxal (1.3). The gel was                extruded through an extrusion head with annular                orifice to form a straight endless tubing. The                inflated tubing was passed through production line                comprising tunnel dryer, shower section, where the                tube was showered with aqueous solution of sodium                bicarbonate and glycerine, tunnel dryer and reeling                station. The reels obtained were thermally treated                and wrapped with a plastic foil to form films. The                film having pH of 5.8, mean thickness of 62                &#956;m and swelling rate of 190% containing                (in weight%) collagen (64), water (13), glycerine                (12), cellulose (4.8), titanium dioxide (4.5) and                salts (1.7) was obtained. The film was humidified                and introduced into thermal transfer printer                equipped with cutting device and labels of                dimension 10 cm&#215;10cm were obtained. The                label was printed with barcode and text clear.                Bovine neck meat was cut into slices with an area                of about 20 cm &#215;10cm and thickness of 3                cm. One label each was stuck on one piece of meat                and a meat roller was passed over the label from                one end to other and back to the starting point to                insure intimate contact. The piece of meat and                label so prepared was put on top of a flat metal                plate which was inserted into lower holder of an                Instron machine. The meat which was not covered by                the label was tied to the metal plate. The free 2                cm wide flap of the label was introduced into the                jaw connected to the mobile crosshead of the                Instron machine and the crosshead was moved upwards                with a speed of 100 mm/min. The maximum force                required to completely remove the label from the                meat was recorded. The labelled meat was tested for                the adhesion of the label within 5 minutes after                labelling, 30 minutes after labelling and after 6                days of storage at 4&#176;C and 80% relative                humidity. The mean adhesive force was 0.9 N within                5 minutes of labelling, 1.1 N after 30 minutes of                labelling and 1.6 N after 6 days of labelling,                after three trials.

AB    NOVELTY - The method involves determining the olfactory                threshold value of the substance, combining the                quantitative and semi-quantitative results,                calculating the odor activity value of each                substance, and analyzing and determining the main                contribution factor of the sample odor without                considering the interaction between odorants. AB    NOVELTY - A composition (C1) for forming marks or                indicia on a polymeric surface upon laser                irradiation comprises: solvent; organic coloring                agent; and agent selected from surfactant and/or                dispersant.
   USE - For forming a mark, indicia, text, or design                on a polymeric surface upon laser irradiation                (claimed); and for forming markings such as                graphics, text and unique identification marks for                traceability such as data matrix and bar codes, or                numbering on plastic surfaces.
   ADVANTAGE - The composition is free from light absorber or                enhancer, and polymeric carrier. The composition                enables formation of high contrast or dark marks on                a polymeric surface and plastics. The marks or                designs formed in accordance with the present                compositions exhibit relatively high durability and                resistance to a host of environmental                factors.
   DETAILED DESCRIPTION - INDEPENDENT CLAIMS are included for the                following:
   forming (M1) a mark, indicia, text, or design                on a polymeric surface, involving applying the                composition (C1) to a polymeric surface to form a                coating; irradiating at least a portion of the                coating with laser light such that regions of the                polymeric surface underlying the coating increase                in temperature and partially encapsulate and retain                the coloring agent;
   forming (M2) in-situ, a dispersion of                polymeric material and functionalized pigment,                involving providing a composition including                functionalized pigment; forming a layer or coating                of the composition on a surface of a polymeric                material; directing light emitted from a laser onto                the layer of the composition so that at least a                portion of the light passes through the layer of                the composition and penetrates into the polymeric                material within at least a region underlying the                layer of the composition thereby causing an                increase in temperature of the polymeric material                such that the polymeric material has a viscosity of                0.25-50000 cps, to thereby form a flowable portion                of the polymeric material; allowing at least a                portion of the functionalized pigment to disperse                within the flowable portion of the polymeric                material to thereby form in-situ a dispersion of                polymeric material and functionalized pigment;                and
   a dispersion of polymeric material and                functionalized pigment produced by the method                (M2).
TF TECHNOLOGY FOCUS - INORGANIC CHEMISTRY - Preferred Components: The solvent is water.                  The coloring agent particles have an average                  particle size of 0.1-100 (preferably 1-10)                  microns. The blue pigments, red pigments, green                  pigments, orange pigments and/or yellow pigments.                  The blue pigment is selected from cobalt                  aluminate, ultramarine blues, and/or complex                  colored inorganic pigment blues (CCIP). The red                  pigment is selected from iron oxide red inorganic                  pigments. The green pigment is selected from                  chrome greens, cobalt greens and/or complex                  inorganic greens. The orange pigment is selected                  from inorganic orange pigment cerium sulfides.                  The yellow pigment is selected from complex                  inorganic yellow pigment, bismuth vanadate and/or                  zinc ferrite. The coloring agent is selected from                  inorganic pigments, mica effect pigments and/or                  metallic effect pigments.
   TECHNOLOGY FOCUS - ORGANIC CHEMISTRY - Preferred Components: The coloring agent is                  in particulate form. The blue pigment is selected                  from phthalocyanine blue, indanthrene blue 60                  and/or indigo blue. The red pigment is selected                  from diketopyrrolopyrrole red, quinacridone 101,                  quinacridone 121, quinacridone violet 19, red                  azo-diazo compounds, perylene red 178, perylene                  red 179, perylene red 149, or other perylene                  compounds. The green pigment is selected from                  phalthalocyanine green. The orange pigment is                  selected from orange 119, diketopyrrolopyrrole                  (DPP) orange 73 and/or pigment orange 67. The                  yellow pigment is selected from isoindoline                  yellow. The coloring agent is selected from                  phthalocyanines or diketopyrrolopyrrole (DPP)                  compounds. The coloring agent is selected from                  organic pigments.
   TECHNOLOGY FOCUS - POLYMERS - Preferred Composition: The composition (C1)                  comprises (%): water (35-65, preferably 40-60);                  coloring agent (2-40, preferably 2-35); and                  surfactant/dispersant (0.1-35, preferably                  0.1-30). Preferred Method: The method (M1)                  further involves: after irradiating, removing any                  remaining composition from the polymeric surface.                  In the method (M1), irradiating with laser light                  is performed using a CO 2laser or fiber laser.                  The method of forming a mark, indicia, text or                  design on a polymeric surface, involves:                  providing a transfer member defining a first                  face, and an oppositely directed second face;                  applying the composition to the first face of the                  transfer member to form a coating; drying the                  coating; contacting the dried coating to the                  surface to be marked; irradiating at least a                  portion of the second face of the transfer member                  such that regions of the polymeric surface                  underlying the coating increase in temperature                  and at least partially encapsulate and retain the                  coloring agent, where the transfer member is a                  tape material, and the first face of the transfer                  member includes an adhesive. The method for                  forming markings or indicia on a polymeric                  surface involves: forming a layer or coating of                  the composition on a surface of a polymeric                  material; directing light emitted from a laser                  onto the layer of the composition, so that the                  light is of a wavelength and energy level such                  that at least a portion of the light passes                  through the layer of the composition and                  penetrates into the polymeric material within at                  least a region underlying the layer of the                  composition thereby causing an increase in                  temperature of the polymeric material so that at                  least a portion of the coloring agent in the                  composition is adhered within the polymeric                  material. In the method for forming markings or                  indicia on a polymeric surface, the increase in                  temperature of the polymeric material is to a                  temperature greater than the glass transition                  temperature and melting point of the polymeric                  material. In the method (M2), the polymeric                  material has a viscosity of 0.5-10000 cps, and                  where the composition including the                  functionalized pigment is free of a polymeric                  carrier and light absorber or enhancer. In the                  method (M2), the dispersion of polymeric material                  and functionalized pigment within the flowable                  portion of the polymeric material exhibits a                  weight ratio of functionalized pigment to                  polymeric material of greater than 50.

TI Controlling dosage of additives and pigments in            recycling process used in processing plant, involves            dosing additives and pigments in polymer recycling and            transformation equipment through operators, comprising            casing which ruptures under specific conditions, and            containing additive and/or pigment.
AU BALIEIRO C O
   DE PAULA DE JESUS A
AE MECA SOLUTIONS LTDA (MECA-Non-standard)
GA 2025A2092G
AB    NOVELTY - Method of controlling dosage of additives and                pigments in recycling processes by disposable                thermoplastic enclosures with programmed rupture                involves dosing additives and pigments in recycling                processes, applied in polymer recycling and                transformation equipment through operators,                comprising a casing containing additive inside the                casing, and ruptures under specific conditions of                temperature, shear, friction or compression                internal to the recycling machine. The casing is                sealed and filled with the precisely dosed additive                or pigment and inserted directly into the polymer                recycling and transformation equipment through the                operator without the need for manual opening,                direct manipulation or external dosers. Once inside                the polymer recycling and transformation equipment,                the casing breaks and releases the contents                directly into the plastic medium being processed,                mixing homogeneously with the compound.
   USE - Method of controlling dosage of additives and                pigments in recycling processes by disposable                thermoplastic enclosures with programmed rupture,                used in small cooperatives and recycler, medium-                and large-scale processing plant, plastic                compounding company, reprocessing facility, and                packaging manufacturer.
   ADVANTAGE - The method operates in a simple and highly                efficient manner by dispensing with pumps, funnels,                valves or external dispensers, adapts to industrial                operations of any size, from small cooperatives to                large-scale industries, can be used manually, with                human operators or automated, with a conveyor belt,                eliminates auxiliary dosing equipment and need for                pumps, dispensers, manual opening of packaging, or                any human contact with the product, optimizes                productivity, and reduces acquisition, maintenance                and factory space costs. Each package contains an                isolated portion, eliminates the risk of residue in                pipes and ensures greater visual uniformity and                process stability between batches or colors, and                can be pre-calibrated with the exact dosage                required for a production cycle, optimizing                consumption and standardizing results. The operator                does not come into direct contact with the pigments                or additives, which prevents accidents, skin                contamination, and exposure to chemical substances.                The ready-to-use casing method allows for quick and                safe input changes, optimizing production line                efficiency. Both the functional content and the                casing itself become portion of the recycled mass,                without generating additional waste, since the                casing is compatible with the polymer to be                recycled. The casing can serve as a pre-calibrated                individual dosing unit and allow traceability                through identification codes (QR codes) or visual                marking.
TF TECHNOLOGY FOCUS - POLYMERS - Preferred Components: The casing comprises a                  disposable packaging made of thermoplastic                  material compatible with the recycling process of                  the polymer in which thermoplastic material can                  be inserted, any type of disposable container,                  closed and made of thermoplastic material                  compatible with the recycling process, including                  sachets, capsules, drums, buckets, plastic bags,                  bottles, and thermal sealing, and including forms                  of mechanical or physical closure. In an                  operator, any and all agents responsible for                  inserting the closed enclosure directly into the                  polymer recycling and transformation equipment,                  including automated insertion with the help of                  equipment.

   USE - Method for packaging a product such as pharmaceutical product e.g. caplet and hard gelatin capsule (all claimed), in cells in a plate i.e. blister. Can also be used for packaging an ampoule.

The method allows reduction in time required to change format of marking the strip using the laser beam, and allows simple programming of lot number and expiration date, thus increasing packaging rate of the products. An adhesive is optically                clear adhesive (OCA), UV curing adhesive or other                optical transparent adhesive. A light absorption                substrate is a black light absorption substrate,                and the reflectivity is less than 10 %, or 5 %, 2                %, 0 %. A light source is D65 standard light                source, and color temperature of the light source                is fixed at 6500K, and the brightness stability                deviation is less than +/ - 1 %. Angle theta is 20-85 degree, or 25 degree,                30 degree, 45 degree, 50 degree, 55 degree, 60                degree, 75 degree. A resolution of a                high-resolution image is 1080p (1920 * 1080 pixel),                2K (2560 * 1440 pixel), 4K (3840 * 2160 pixel) or                higher resolution.

AU HU Z
   TANG X
   JIANG W
   SHA X
   TU Z
AE UNIV JIANGXI NORMAL (UYJX-C)
GA 2023266142
AB    NOVELTY - Identifying carp fish gelatin involves (a)                establishing theoretical characteristic peptide                database of carps gelatin by extracting amino acid                sequence of carps type I collagen from the NCBI                database, and establishing common characteristics                of carps gelatin were by using protein sequence                alignment software combined with                collagenase-trypsin combination simulation                digestion (number of missing cut sites is set to                0-2) and unique characteristic peptide database;                and (b) pre-treating carp scales by washing scales                of 7 kinds of carps collected with clear water to                remove dirt and mucus on the surface of the scales,                using a tissue grinder for 5-10 minutes to remove                the silvery substance on the surface of the fish                scales, and washing with water, and using                0.2-1.0mol/L hydrogen chloride (HCl) solution to                decalcify fish scales at a ratio of 1:5-1:20 (w/v)                for 0.5-3.0 hours, pouring out the acid solution,                and then washing the fish scales with water until                pH value is 5.5-7.0.
   USE - Method for identifying carp fish                gelatin.
   ADVANTAGE - The method identifies carp fish gelatin, which                improves accuracy, authenticity of traceability and                identification of carps gelatin.
   DETAILED DESCRIPTION - Identifying carp fish gelatin involves (a)                establishing theoretical characteristic peptide                database of carps gelatin by extracting amino acid                sequence of carps type I collagen from the NCBI                database, and establishing common characteristics                of carps gelatin were by using protein sequence                alignment software combined with                collagenase-trypsin combination simulation                digestion (the number of missing cut sites is set                to 0-2) and unique characteristic peptide database;                (b) pre-treating carp scales by washing scales of 7                kinds of carps collected with clear water to remove                dirt and mucus on the surface of the scales, using                a tissue grinder for 5-10 minutes to remove the                silvery substance on the surface of the fish                scales, and washing with water, and using                0.2-1.0mol/L hydrogen chloride (HCl) solution to                decalcify fish scales at a ratio of 1:5-1:20 (w/v)                for 0.5-3.0 hours, pouring out the acid solution,                and then washing the fish scales with water until                the pH value is 5.5-7.0; (c) extracting carp fish                scale gelatin by adding deionized water to the                pre-treated fish scales, covering with plastic                wrap, heating in water bath at 50-100&#176;C                for 1-6 hours, filtering and freeze-drying fish                gelatin solution to obtain carp fish scale gelatin;                (d) performing enzymatic hydrolysis of carp fish                scale gelatin by dissolving dried fish scale                gelatin sample in SDT buffer to make 1-10mg/mL fish                gelatin solution, heating it in a water bath at                80-100&#176;C for 2-10 minutes, centrifuging,                putting the supernatant in a 10-20kDa                ultrafiltration centrifuge tube, adding                100-300&#956;L UA buffer, placing it in a                centrifuge, adding UA buffer and centrifuging it                again, repeating it for 1-3 times, adding                100-200&#956;l of UA buffer solution of                50-100mmol/L iodoacetic acid, and placing it in a                dark room for 10-60 minutes, and centrifuging it at                3000-10000 revolutions per minute (rpm) for 10-30                minutes to obtain a gelatin concentrate; dissolving                the gelatin concentrate in 250-300&#956;L of                activation buffer, adding 2-3&#956;L of 1mg/mL                collagenase, standing at 30-45&#176;C                overnight, centrifuging, collecting the filtrate,                and obtaining the first enzymatic hydrolysis                product, and then adding 100-200&#956;L of UA                buffer solution to the first enzymatic hydrolysis                product, and placing it in a dark room for 10-60                minutes, and then centrifuging it at a speed of                3000-10000 rpm for 10-30 minutes, adding                1-2&#956;L of 1mg/mL trypsin, standing it                overnight at 30-45&#176;C, centrifuging,                collecting the filtrate, and obtaining the second                enzymatic hydrolysis product; (e) loading second                enzymatic hydrolysis product on Easy nLC-Orbitrap                Fusion Tribrid mass spectrometer for detection,                injecting it into C18 chromatographic column, using                mobile phase A containing 0.1-0.5 % (v/v) formic                acid in water, mobile phase B is acetonitrile                solution containing 0.1-0.5% (v/v) formic acid                (acetonitrile content is 70-95% and rest is water)                at a flow rate of 200-300nl/minutes, carrying out                elution for 40-90 minutes, where linear gradient                changes from mobile phase A to mobile phase B,                using data-dependent acquisition mode to                dynamically collect the 5-20 parent ions with the                highest abundance for HCD cracking, where dynamic                exclusion time is 10-20 seconds and collision                energy is 20-30eV, and recording the obtained mass                spectrogram, where recorded mass spectrogram                include a primary mass spectrogram and a secondary                mass spectrogram; (f) using MASCOT software to                match and analyze the mass spectrograms obtained,                and database is set to the target collagen                database, where search parameters include cysteine                which is fixed and modified by iodoacetamide, and                oxidation is a possible modification, where the                largest uncut site is 1-5, error rate of primary                mass spectrometry is &#177;(10-30)ppm, and                secondary mass spectrometry error rate is                &#177;(0.1-0.5)Da, and when Mascot score is                greater than 40 then peptide peak is considered to                be positively identified or the accuracy is                extremely high (P &lt; 0.05); and (g)                identifying source of carps gelatin by matching                common characteristic peptides of 7 kinds of carps                gelatin identified database and their own unique                characteristic peptide database based on the mass                spectrometry detection results and the common and                unique theoretical characteristic peptide database                of carps gelatin established in step (a), and then                species of carp gelatin is accurately                identified.
TF TECHNOLOGY FOCUS - BIOLOGY - Preferred Conditions: The method involves                  selecting samples again after step (f) and                  repeating steps (a-f) and the result of the                  obtained polypeptide peak is identified as a                  positive identification (P &lt; 0.05) which                  is at least the average value of three sets of                  repeated data. The SDT buffer is a mixed solution                  containing 1-4% sodium dodecyl sulfate,                  20-100mmol/L dithiothreitol and 100-200mmol/L                  tris(hydroxymethyl)aminomethane hydrochloride at                  pH 7.5-8.5. The UA buffer is a mixed solution                  containing 5-20mmol/L urea and 100-200mmol/L                  tris(hydroxymethyl)aminomethane hydrochloride at                  pH 7.5-8.5. The activation buffer is a mixed                  solution containing 5-10&#956;mol/L calcium                  chloride, 2-6&#956;mol/L zinc chloride,                  150-200 mmol/L tris(hydroxymethyl)aminomethane                  hydrochloride, and pH is 7.5.
